rankedWhiteVsE5.name: Vienna (with the Vienna Gambit)
rankedWhiteVsE5.moves: 1.e4 e5 2.Nc3, then 3.f4 for the gambit. Don’t mix this with c3.

blackCandidates.name: Pirc Defence
blackCandidates.note: Setup is easy; the work is the attacking plan after it. See the Fianchetto module and the Pirc & Modern plan chapters.

blackCandidates.name: Rousseau Gambit
blackCandidates.note: If he plays 3.Bb5 instead of 3.Bc4, the cousin is the Schliemann (3...f5). If he plays 3.d4, that’s a Scotch — not a Rousseau.

blackCandidates.name: Caro-Kann
blackCandidates.note: Use the Pirc/Modern setup against everything that isn’t 1.e4.

doNotMix: Do not combine c3 with an early f4 in the same game. c3 wants a slow d4 center and takes c3 from the knight; the Vienna Gambit needs Nc3 and a fast f4. Together they loosen the kingside (e3 and g1) without either plan working, and he can hit …d5 while your king is still on e1.
